# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-B: Exported Yearly Hook oe_ux2_kernel_yearly & Cartography Showcase Dispatcher (0 debug_log) (oe_ux2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_mapmodes_ledger.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country scope: increment cartographic survey counter read by oe_ux2_val_reactive_events.
oe_ux2_bump_survey_count = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ux2_survey_count }
		change_variable = { name = oe_ux2_survey_count add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_ux2_survey_count value = 1 }
	}
}

# Exported O(1) zero-slot yearly hook (called from global yearly kernel; self-deduped per year).
oe_ux2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:oe_ux2_ran_y ?= current_year }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ux2_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_showcase_eligible_trigger = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1340
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ux2_ev1_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ux2_ev1_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ux2.1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1490
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ux2_ev2_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ux2_ev2_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ux2.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						current_year >= 1560
						num_of_non_rural >= 12
					}
					has_variable = oe_ux2_ev1_done
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ux2_ev3_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ux2_ev3_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ux2.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						current_year >= 1610
						has_global_variable = oe_clim_lia_wave
					}
					has_variable = oe_ux2_ev1_done
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ux2_ev4_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ux2_ev4_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ux2.4
			}
		}
	}
}
